resource: Reward principals (characters eligible for a creature death's XP) settled per death
allocation_impact: PARTY-XP-1: at most 50 distinct Character principals in CharacterId order. One native sequencer and one XP receipt per awarded Character; all member awards and the kill audit commit in one transaction. Zero stamina removes an award without redistributing it. The compatibility solo composition still admits exactly one principal.
boundary_tests: same-death concurrent retry and recovered sequencers: party_xp_concurrent_replay_and_recovered_sequencers_do_not_award_twice (canonical PostgreSQL 17.6)
notes: D109/D118 and PARTY_PVP0 §5.1 supersede the single-principal ceiling for the shared-XP owner. One receipt per (death, Character), never another award on retry.
